author: smcarus
title: Will Brent crude be higher on 28 May 2027 than on 2 April 2027?
summary: Give the probability that the price of Brent crude oil (US EIA daily spot price) on the first day published on or after 28 May 2027 is higher than on the day entries close, 2 April 2027. A term-length Quest: the result comes 8 weeks after entries close, so a class can follow it and discuss what moved the price.
knownLimits: EIA publishes daily spot prices a few days late; the Quest settles when the value for the date is out.
Over 8 weeks, supply decisions, the world economy and the dollar all move oil; nobody knows most of that news in advance.
